name: Rare Books

angles.text: As a mage, you may recognize the basic principles in these primers. Their lessons have reached kobolds beneath the earth.
As an Alliance member, you help recover books stolen from Northshire Abbey and aid the local militia.

faq.answer: You are asked to recover the last two books missing from Brother Paxton's catalog. Kobolds have taken them into Jasperlode Mine.
faq.q: What is the quest Rare Books?

faq.answer: Brother Paxton is a cleric at Northshire Abbey who cares for its books and documents. Kobolds have taken volumes from the library, and he needs them returned.
The missing books are Geomancy for Curious Young Wizards and Arcane Explainer: Magical Stuff in Simple Words. Both introduce arcane and magical theory.
faq.q: Which books need to be recovered?

faq.answer: The missing books are in Jasperlode Mine in Northshire Valley. Kobold diggers and geomancers occupy the gold mine.
faq.q: Where are the missing books located?

faq.answer: Kobolds in Jasperlode Mine appear to be using the books to study geomancy and spellcasting. An apprentice has tried to summon an elemental.
faq.q: Why did the kobolds take books on magic?

faq.answer: Brother Paxton gives helpers spare weapons set aside for the Northshire militia. He believes adventurers facing threats in the valley can put them to better use.
faq.q: Why does Brother Paxton reward weapons intended for the militia?

sections.body: Brother Paxton has lost two books from the library at Northshire Abbey. Kobolds carrying books and other things have taken them into Jasperlode Mine. The missing volumes are Geomancy for Curious Young Wizards and Arcane Explainer: Magical Stuff in Simple Words. Both are primers on magic.
sections.title: Missing from the Abbey

sections.body: Kobolds in Jasperlode Mine are studying the stolen books. An apprentice has already tried to summon an elemental. No one knows what a more practiced geomancer might call forth from those lessons.
sections.title: Arcane Kobolds in Jasperlode

summary: In Northshire Valley, Rare Books sends you after two primers taken by kobolds. Brother Paxton needs them back at Northshire Abbey.
